main_claim: H200 Setup speedup exceeds 3x in the recorded n=65536 observation; measured CPU/GPU ratio 3.9851548300993116; not whole-system speedup

h200_1291.samples: One diagnostic process per mode; Setup/Prove/ordinary initialization one API observation; ordinary Update median of 4; full rebuild Update mean of 2 after 2 warmups
h200_1291.timer: Rust std::time::Instant; process wall Python time.monotonic_ns

cpu_local_statistic: Per scale, 3 alternating fresh-process pairs (reference/candidate, candidate/reference, reference/candidate). Ordinary Update is median of 4 requests per process then median of 3 process medians. Full rebuild is route1 two-update total/2 then median of 3 processes.

r5_bundle.mechanism_zh: 按规模选择window/变换批大小，复用frozen线性项、前台线性项、global G2和未变缓存；使用有界G1解码及经真实校准选择的affine读回。各规模只按真实计数声明机制命中。
r5_bundle.baseline: IncrementalSession defaults + ForceGpu + same size-selected window
r5_bundle.timer: sum of two measured caller update intervals; excludes calibration, setup, session initialization and external Reference
limits: The local n256 JSON does not record a Git commit; do not silently assign the n1024 supplement commit to it.
n65536 packet calls and support geometry reuse are 0; these mechanisms are not covered at that size.
Feature counters include warmups; n256 also includes additional functional sequences.
Not an original-paper whole-system baseline or end-to-end speedup.

prepared_capacity.mechanism_zh: 固定SRS与域的公开根/divisor/prepared-G2前缀预计算并跨epoch复用，减少重复divisor构造及G2 prepare；每笔保留2n条独立Product方程、Miller和最终幂。
prepared_capacity.only_change: prepared-root capacity 64/256/1024/4096, actual min(n, cap), deduplicated by actual capacity
prepared_capacity.timer: sum of two measured updates; precompute is included in initialization
limits: Two timed updates per route; fixed deterministic workload; no significance claim.
Default remained64; larger capacity is opt-in.
Per-owner envelope and requested retained bytes are not process RSS/VRAM peaks.
Prepared reuse does not cache acceptance, witnesses, Miller loops or final exponentiations.

full_domain_divisor.mechanism_zh: 一次构造公开affine G2 divisor全域表D_r=P1-rP0，update仍先用prepared64，其余按根查表，免去重复点乘；只缓存公开固定数据，所有独立配对方程继续执行。
full_domain_divisor.timer: sum of two measured updates after two warmups; both routes already use R5; only divisor cache toggles
limits: Independent equations/Miller/final-exponentiation count per complete update = 2*n.
The21.395530 s precompute is already in the260.695464 s On initialization.
Phase sum is arithmetic of shared setup + route initialization + all4 updates, not an independently timed process.
Two samples are not statistically significant evidence.

cache_workers_update.mechanism_zh: CPU侧专用有界worker池并行验证cache方程，64根块、每任务4根、最多16任务；每条方程保留独立Miller与最终幂。GPU session顺序重放，同时最多1个owner。
cache_workers_update.hardware: 1 H200 and8 allocated CPU slots at every worker setting; n262144 reserves64 GiB host
cache_workers_update.only_change: CPU cache-check workers1/2/4/8; runs in fixed1/2/4/8 order
cache_workers_update.timer: mean of two measured On caller updates; Off means also retained
limits: One independent process per setting; two timed updates per route; fixed order.
CPU parallelism reduces wall time, not the equation count or necessarily cumulative worker elapsed work.
At n262144,8-worker Miller+final-exp worker elapsed across two updates is about1408.99 s vs serial947.98 s.
Later host-memory and GPU-pairing research is outside this snapshot.
The old n65536 JSON retains a failed-first-attempt followup field; the later n262144 retry report and sealed JSON govern accepted n262144 data.

cache_workers_full_process.mechanism_zh: 与同轮worker实验相同；用独立全进程回执衡量初始化、稳态与验收整体墙钟。
cache_workers_full_process.timer: independently measured complete two-route benchmark executable; setup, readback calibration, Off/On initialization,4 updates per route (8 total),Reference,exact witness I/O,owner release and2 CPU dense oracles
limits: Not single-route service latency, single proof verification latency or cold-start+one-update wall time.
One full-process sample per setting; fixed worker order; no significance claim.
Do not add nested phase times or multiply full-process and update ratios.

fixed_base_divisor_constructor.mechanism_zh: 对同一公开SRS点P0复用固定基点窗口表计算P1-rP0，n<128直接乘，128至2048用4位，n>=4096用8位；最多64根一批，临时表发布前释放。
fixed_base_divisor_constructor.hardware: local CPU constructor component; published result does not record CPU model
fixed_base_divisor_constructor.timer: single fixed-order component interval including table build,multiplication,normalization and output storage; final table/output destruction outside
limits: One fixed-order single-process sample per strategy/size, not significance.
Constructor gain is not whole-initialization, update or process speedup.
Original non--locked attempt excluded; use source-frozen R2 only.
No new H200/SM90 validation belongs to this local constructor sample;1174 reports its own later absolute constructor times.

basis_initialization_batching.mechanism_zh: Program::new的公开basis FourStep FFT改用已有initialization_plan，n1024/长度2048的行提交96次降为2次，transpose复用初始化tile；每批最多65536元素，数学五阶段、总算术与自然序输出不变。
basis_initialization_batching.hardware: RTX5070Ti Laptop / sm_120, n1024/window8, same probe/native/image and deterministic inputs
basis_initialization_batching.timer: basis FFT and Program body are nested host call wall; process wall independently timed
limits: One historical C0 process and one C1 process, not repeated statistical samples.
Other phases also fluctuate; complete-process difference is not fully attributable to basis batching.
Process includes shared setup/calibration,2 initializations,8updates,Reference,exact witness I/O and2 CPU dense; excludes build,container startup and hashes.
No H200,different-circuit cold-start distribution or large-scale execution result.
No same-n cache,SRS persistent copy or cross-owner device-handle sharing; each session computes its own basis.
Call wall is not CUDA-event kernel time.

h200_1174_checkpoint.mechanism_zh: 冻结历史综合快照的完整验收及热点拆分；Off/On只切换全域divisor缓存。
limits: One process per scale and two measured updates per route; Off then On.
The ratio is marginal cache gain within shared optimizations, not total project gain.
No uniformly controlled original-Dynaverse-vs-latest end-to-end baseline exists.
Native reuse is not new compilation or runtime algorithm speedup.
Cache worker elapsed sums are not process wall or CPU cycles.
n262144 uses8GiB/owner, not2GiB; resource observations are5s samples, not certified peaks.
n4194304 whole circuit remains unadmitted.
